messages:
nina: Quick heads-up — planning a config-only rollout this evening to tighten geo-affinity routing for EU tenants and reduce tinybatch window there. No model changes.
deploy-bot: /schedule config-roll 1719876543 20:00 UTC (canary 3% EU -> 15% -> 100%), config-id=cfg_geo_v2
paul: 👍 what's changing exactly? timeouts or batching?
sophia: tinybatch window from 40ms -> 25ms for EU, routing weight bump to prefer local replicas, and a per-tenant concurrency floor for paid tiers. Also shaving idle-ttl from 120s -> 90s.
ops-jen: Are we pinning any routes to versions? if something goes sideways can we route back to current behavior quickly?
nina: Not pinning model versions. We will pin routing policy for the canary slices. Plan is: canary at 03:00 rollout window (low traffic in EU), observe token latency + kvcache pressure for 30m, then scale to 15% if metrics OK. Rollback plan: revert cfg_geo_v2 or unpin slices.
paul: Add me for the 20:00 watch. I'll have synthetic traffic running against EU region to look for tail latency and kv hits.
matt: Suggest we also enable the routing-fallback timer at 150ms so that requests don't linger into cross-region fallback unless necessary. Small safety net.
sophia: Good call. I'll add fallback_timer_ms:150 to the canary config. snippet: ```json
{
  "batch_window_ms": 25,
  "routing_preference": "local_first",
  "fallback_timer_ms": 150,
  "idle_ttl_s": 90
}
```
ops-jen: Can the deploy-bot annotate the release notes with the exact params and the safety rollback commands?
deploy-bot: scheduled by nina for 2024-07-31T20:00:00Z. Ops play: rollback command -> `/deploybot revert-config cfg_geo_v2` or manual: `PATCH /config-region?region=eu&cfg=previous`. Release notes link: https://intranet/release-notes/1719876543
paul: If we hit kvcache pressure, what's our immediate action? revert or throttle?
sophia: Immediate: revert to prior config. If we see partial issues (high kv miss but infra stable) we can dial batching back up (batch_window_ms -> 40) for affected tenants via feature-flag. Revert path is faster though.
matt: Logging checklist: ensure per-route traces are on, add a short eval prompt set for EU tenant traffic, and set regression alert for 10% degradation in p95 latency or >5% increase in token cost.
nina: Checklist for rollout (short):
- PR merged and config-id pinned: cfg_geo_v2
- Deploy-bot scheduled 20:00 UTC
- Canary slice = EU small cohort 3%
- Metrics watch: p50/p95 latency, kv miss rate, tail GPU mem pressure
- Rollback commands posted in thread (above)
- Post-mortem owner: paul if any incidents

paul: I'll be watching metrics and synthetic probes. ping me if anything weird.
ops-jen: I'll keep an eye on infra and be ready to flip the revert command.
sophia: I'll push the tiny change and add the fallback timer. No infra deploys required.
nina: Cool — rolling out as planned. If anything unexpected, call rollback within the first 15 minutes. :rotating_light:
